description: Designs a map poster and shows it in the chat. Use this when the user wants a map poster, map print, map wall art or map wallpaper of a real place, or a map poster as an anniversary, Valentine's, wedding, engagement or housewarming gift tied to a place: where a couple met or married, a first home, a hometown, a city someone is leaving, a trip, a marathon someone ran or a birthplace. Not for general gift advice, directions, travel plans, star or night-sky maps, photo posters, 3D, wooden, scratch-off or push-pin maps, or hiking trails and GPX tracks. Takes a city, neighborhood, address, landmark or coordinates (up to three places) and links to the MapPoster editor to fine-tune it or, in the drawn map styles, order it printed. Give a `place` or `lat`/`lon`; the rest is optional. Nothing is saved or bought: the design lives in the link.

bearing.description: Map rotation in degrees (default 0, north up).

coordinates.description: Custom text for the coordinates line. Default: the map centre coordinates.

height.description: Custom canvas height in px (overrides size).

language.description: Language for place names, e.g. "nl" or "de" (default "en"). Use the user's language.

marker_color.description: Marker colour as #RRGGBB. Default: the theme accent.

markers.description: Pins on the map, e.g. a home or the spot where a couple met.

mat_border.description: Thin line around the map inside the mat (default on).

more_places.description: Up to two more places on the same poster, each with its own map and a label under it, e.g. where a couple met, got engaged and married. The first map is `place` (or lat/lon); markers and the route stay on it. Artistic themes only; the maps are rectangular (shape is ignored) and the title sits under them (text_x/text_y are ignored).

label.description: Text under this map: the user's own words if they give them, otherwise in their language, e.g. "Where we got engaged". Default: the place name.

place.description: The place, e.g. "Paris" or "Central Park, New York". Used when lat/lon are not given (first search match).

zoom.description: Default: the suggested zoom for the place.

place.description: The place the user wants on the poster, e.g. "Utrecht" or "Brooklyn, New York". Used when lat/lon are not given (first search match).

place_label.description: With more_places: the label under the first map, in the user's words or language. Default: its place name.

places_layout.description: With more_places: the maps stacked or side by side. Default auto: side by side on a landscape or square poster, else stacked.

route.description: A route along the roads (driving directions) from start to end, through up to 10 via points: a road trip, or a road race such as a marathon, traced through points along its course.

route_color.description: Route colour as #RRGGBB. Default: the theme route colour.

shape.description: Map shape (default rectangle); circle, hexagon and heart make the canvas square.

show_map_labels.description: Street, place and water names on the map, for the themes that offer them (midnight_dark, minimal_white, modern_voyager). Default on.

size.description: Canvas size preset: poster_portrait (1080×1527), poster_landscape (1527×1080), square (1080×1080), instagram_portrait (1080×1350), story (1080×1920), pinterest (1000×1500), desktop_wallpaper (1920×1080), a4 (2480×3508), a3 (3508×4961), a2 (4961×7016), 18x24in (5400×7200). Default poster_portrait.

subtitle.description: Second line: the user's own words if they give them, otherwise in their language. Default: the country. Can be a date or a short message.

text_background.description: Shading behind the text for readability (default none). Not used with a shape: a heart, circle or hexagon keeps its own edge.

text_size.description: Size of the text block (default medium); "none" hides all text.

theme.description: Theme key (see list_themes). standard and satellite are classic map tiles for personal use; all others are artistic vector styles.

title.description: Main poster text: the user's own words if they give them, otherwise in their language. Default: the place name. Can be personal, e.g. "WHERE IT ALL BEGAN" or two names.

width.description: Custom canvas width in px (overrides size).

zoom.description: Zoom: ~11 metro area, 13 city, 15 neighbourhood, 16-17 a few streets. Default: the suggested zoom for the place.
